estimand: Incremental held-out predictive value of domain-varying distance relationships after accounting for domain intercepts and clipped-cell exposure.

outcome.meaning: at least one compiled USGS occurrence in the cell; binary, not a count

area.definition: 5 km cell footprint intersected with the union of the five USGS permissive tracts
area.offset: log(area_km2); fixed coefficient 1 in the cloglog models

predictors.lithology: litho_contact_litho_class indicators retained when the training partition has both labels
predictors.area: log_area_km2 exposure offset; standardized covariate only in the area-covariate sensitivity

M0_global.equation: cloglog(p_i) = alpha + b_f1 z_f + b_f2 z_f^2 + b_l1 z_l + b_l2 z_l^2 + b_g g + x_rock'b_rock + log(A_i)

M1_domain_intercept.equation: cloglog(p_i) = alpha_d[i] + b_f1 z_f + b_f2 z_f^2 + b_l1 z_l + b_l2 z_l^2 + b_g g + x_rock'b_rock + log(A_i)

M2_domain_distance.equation: cloglog(p_i) = alpha_d[i] + b_f1[d(i)] z_f + b_f2[d(i)] z_f^2 + b_l1[d(i)] z_l + b_l2[d(i)] z_l^2 + b_g g + x_rock'b_rock + log(A_i)

M3_domain_distance_gravity.equation: cloglog(p_i) = alpha_d[i] + b_f1[d(i)] z_f + b_f2[d(i)] z_f^2 + b_l1[d(i)] z_l + b_l2[d(i)] z_l^2 + b_g[d(i)] g + x_rock'b_rock + log(A_i)

V14_control.equation: logit(p_i) = alpha_d[i] + b_f1[d(i)] z_f + b_f2[d(i)] z_f^2 + b_l1[d(i)] z_l + b_l2[d(i)] z_l^2 + b_g g + x_rock'b_rock

M2_logit_no_area.equation: logit(p_i) = alpha_d[i] + b_f1[d(i)] z_f + b_f2[d(i)] z_f^2 + b_l1[d(i)] z_l + b_l2[d(i)] z_l^2 + b_g g + x_rock'b_rock

M2_logit_area_covariate.equation: logit(p_i) = alpha_d[i] + b_f1[d(i)] z_f + b_f2[d(i)] z_f^2 + b_l1[d(i)] z_l + b_l2[d(i)] z_l^2 + b_g g + x_rock'b_rock + b_A z_A

M2_cloglog_no_litho.equation: cloglog(p_i) = alpha_d[i] + b_f1[d(i)] z_f + b_f2[d(i)] z_f^2 + b_g g + log(A_i)

deviations_from_v14: V15 primary models use a complementary log-log likelihood with log clipped-cell area as a fixed offset.
M2 and M3 were refitted after an initial run produced 2-11 divergences per fold; the initial traces are archived under paper_1/v15/models/nonconverged_initial and are not used for inference.
The retained M2 and M3 runs use four chains, 1,500 draws, 2,500 tuning steps and target_accept 0.995; M0 and M1 use the earlier convergent two-chain configuration.

The V14_control is a new V15 re-specification with the V14 likelihood, predictors and priors, not a byte reproduction of the frozen V14 chains. V14 itself used 1,500 draws, 2,500 tuning steps, two chains and target_accept 0.99.
The frozen V14 OOF predictions remain the exact benchmark; no V14 file is modified.
